propositions: DC outbound status changes are submitted as field edits via issue.update(fields=...) instead of being routed to transition_issue_by_name, causing the status to never actually change on the remote issue
Cloud ACLI transport pops status from kwargs and routes it through transition resolution, but DC transport does not perform this routing, creating a parity gap between backends
status is not an editable field in Jira REST API; it is only reachable through workflow transitions, so Jira silently rejects field-edit attempts without error

the fix extracts the transition cluster logic to adapters/jira_datacenter/transitions.py and modifies update_issue to pop status and route it through route_status_to_transition before issue.update is called
illegal transitions must remain non-fatal and observable in bridge_alerts rather than failing fast, preserving the existing error handling contract
